subject: Call for help -- inteprating R script of GMM analysis and collaboration on paper

messages.author: 7d095260437531ce
messages.subject: Call for help -- inteprating R script of GMM analysis and collaboration on paper
parts:
Dear all,

We are working on a project to investigate the 3D morphological variations of a bone of sheep under the influence of living habitats, age, and sex. The previous collaborators have already done some GMM analysis using morpho J and Geomorph in R. Now they have left the project but there are remaining issues to be solved.

In order to finish the project and publish the paper, we need collaborators who are familiar with this kind of analysis and able to work together closely to finish the paper.

The work will be paid with up to 1000 pounds (for the whole project).

Looking forward to reply.

Thanks in advance.

Best regards,
Yiru
